props.title: 7-Speed Bicycle
props.subtitle: Five connected systems — select a system or pin to explore its role.

hotspots.label: A strong foundation
hotspots.detail: Two triangles connect the saddle, steering and pedals. The fork holds the front wheel and turns with the bars.

hotspots.label: Made to keep rolling
hotspots.detail: Spokes connect each hub to its rim and support the rider. The tires surround the rims and grip the ground.

hotspots.label: Seven ways to move
hotspots.detail: The pedals turn the chain, driving the rear wheel. Seven gears let the rider adjust pedaling effort for climbs, flats and descents.

hotspots.label: Control at the rim
hotspots.detail: Hand levers pull cables that bring the brake pads against the rims, turning a squeeze into controlled slowing.

hotspots.label: Steering and support
hotspots.detail: The handlebars and stem steer the front wheel. The saddle and seatpost support the rider and set the sitting position.
